local origin = Vector3.new(0, 900, 1150) local target = Vector3.new(0, 620, 800) local out = {} for _, folder in {workspace.Sanctuary.KarstHorizon, workspace.Sanctuary.CloudSea} do for _, m in folder:GetChildren() do if m:IsA('Model') then local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox() for t = 0, 1, 0.02 do local p = cf:PointToObjectSpace(origin:Lerp(target, t)) if math.abs(p.X) < size.X/2 and math.abs(p.Y) < size.Y/2 and math.abs(p.Z) < size.Z/2 then table.insert(out, m.Name .. string.format(' t=%.2f size=%.0f,%.0f,%.0f at %.0f,%.0f,%.0f', t, size.X, size.Y, size.Z, cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z)) break end end end end end return #out .. ': ' .. table.concat(out, ' | ')
